shared_elements: frontal anthropomorphic figure carved on an upright columnar/blocky monolith
schematic human face with recessed eyes
brow ridge / nose rendered as a continuous ridge
cap or headdress covering the top of the head, with a straight lower edge across the brow
broad flat rectangular body/support below the head
justification: Both depict a frontal, rigidly symmetrical anthropomorphic figure on an upright block, with a schematic face of deep-set eyes under a straight-edged cap or headdress sitting directly atop a broad flat body-mass, which is a reasonably specific shared scheme. The chief difference in content is that B carries a whole articulated programme below the head — shoulders, arms converging on the abdomen, relief ornaments across the chest, a large disc at the belly and a belt-like band — none of which is present or implied in A, which is confined to a face and headdress with no incised detail.
